provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Spirit Island core rulebook (Greater Than Games)

modules.name: Feather & Flame
modules.note: New Spirits and Adversaries; no setup changes.

steps.text: Choose an Adversary and/or Scenario first - they change setup
Invader Board on one side of the play area
Add the Invader Board extension; Beasts, Wilds, Disease and Strife tokens on it
Beasts, Wilds, Disease, Strife and Badlands tokens in a supply by the island
Add Badlands tokens to the supply
{n} Fear markers into the Fear Pool (4 per player)
Shuffle the Fear cards; 9 on the Fear Deck space with Terror Level dividers 3 and 6 cards from the bottom
Invader Deck from the bottom: 5 random Stage III, 4 Stage II, 3 Stage I - on the Explore space
Random Blight card, Healthy Island side up, with the Blight it shows + 1 extra
steps.note: Erratum: exactly 1 extra Blight regardless of player count

steps.text: Shuffle the Event deck (a Blight card is now required)
Shuffle the Event deck (a Blight card is now required)
Remove the Event "A Strange Madness Among the Beasts" with Russia or Many Minds Move as One
One random Island Board per player, arranged into the Island
Invaders, Dahan and Blight on each land as its icons show
On each board: a Beasts token in the lowest-numbered land with no Setup icons, a Disease token in land #2
On each board: a Beasts token in the lowest-numbered land with no Setup icons, a Disease token in land #2
Shuffle the Minor and Major Power decks by the board, room for discards
Energy, Cities, Towns, Explorers and Dahan within everyone's reach
Each player takes a color's Presence and markers, a Spirit panel and its 4 Unique Powers
steps.note: New players: a low-complexity Spirit and its Power Progression card

steps.text: Each Spirit on its own board: follow the Setup on the back of its panel
Spirits with an Incarna place it as their Setup says
Flip the panel; remaining Presence on the dashed circles of the Presence tracks
Thematic boards: place tokens by the Setup icons instead
Spirits aren't restricted to their starting board after setup
Invaders' starting action: reveal the top Invader card, Explore that land type, then move it to Build
Begin with the first Spirit Phase
